implementation.state: Explicit loading/ready/pending/unavailable/signin/changed read states plus ephemeral known/unknown mutation confirmation. Stores action, accepted requestId, owner/workspace or known order/device context and server saved revision; no private body or credential in storage.
implementation.ack: Only accepted:true + safe revision at least the submitted base revision marks known saved. It never grants current read/execute, contract activation, payment, job completion or device acceptance. POST body is not used as a current view; a fresh GET is required even on normal success.
implementation.recovery: Fresh view must retain server canRead===true, same owner/workspace/order/device or pre-accept known order/device, revision>=ack revision. A run must contain the accepted requestId, so unrelated revision growth cannot clear reconciliation. A changed context clears private inputs/body and remains blocked; restoration requires fresh matching original context or explicit page reload/new entry.
implementation.render: All workspace/job/usage/invoice/export/new-contract and author mutation UI is hidden outside ready. Null response after known workspace/ack is not treated as no contract. Null/500 do not restore an old actionable body;401/403 shows current-read/sign-in denial distinctly. Current usage null stays unconfirmed instead of defaulting measured usage to16USD. Public16USD contract wording and existing rates unchanged.
implementation.raceFences: Synchronous mutation lock plus current rendered-view equality rejects duplicate or retained stale handlers before another POST or UUID allocation. Read sequence discards older responses. Lifecycle/connection-check generation invalidation rejects late POST/GET and prevents unmounted writes. Reuses existing sky-execution-access-check event plus window blur/focus/pageshow; only read-only GET is automatic on recheck. Attempt2 adds document.visibilitychange setup/cleanup. Hidden/non-visible state invalidates generation/read sequence/flight, clears private view and form drafts, retains only known/unknown pending correlation. canMutate, refresh start, async response acceptance and ready-body render all independently require visible. Visible/focus/pageshow rechecks send fresh GET only; hidden rechecks cannot fetch or restore authority.
implementation.validation: Known validation4xx without owner/auth conflict clears pending then re-reads the current server view before returning editable flow, preserving validation message and draft inputs. It does not restore a former-owner body from cached state. Owner/auth conflicts clear private context; no automatic retry.
implementation.paymentBoundary: Existing payment endpoint/currency/price/claim logic untouched. UI payment/download handlers share current-view/synchronous guards and generation checks; no payment request can start from a pending acknowledgement or retained stale handler. Existing operationRequest is reused for normal timeout, redirects and error envelopes.
implementation.ordinaryFlow: A genuine initial current empty workspace with no pending/previous context still exposes deliberate existing terms/consent; selected eligible order/device must match the current eligible list. No automatic accept.

mustFix.title: visibilitychange does not quarantine or fence current and late private responses
mustFix.cause: Effect listens only for window blur/focus/pageshow/access-check. document.visibilitychange is not handled, and canMutate/refresh result acceptance do not check document.visibilityState.
reproduction: Load authorized view; set document.visibilityState=hidden and dispatch visibilitychange without a separate blur event. Retained current stop handler sends POST1 (expected0).

Start mutation, receive ack revision8 and issue GET. Hide via visibilitychange; resolve pre-hide GET with matching revision8. Private body and mutation controls are restored while hidden. Return visible via visibilitychange: GET count stays2, no fresh authority read.
mustFix.impact: The explicitly requested visibility boundary does not invalidate old responses or current actionable private UI. A matching old GET can unlock controls across hidden/visible transition without a fresh current-authority check. This is a hook-fixture UI race, not proof of server authorization bypass or an actual charge.
mustFix.requiredFix: Add visibilitychange setup/cleanup that invalidates generation/read state and hides private UI on hidden, then requires a fresh read on visible. Gate retained actions and successful read restoration against hidden visibility; keep known/unknown pending identity and avoid POST replay. Preserve ordinary visible initial load and successful recovery.
acceptance: Both independent visibility counterexamples pass with POST0 for retained hidden handler and no hidden private/action restoration.
Visible return performs GET only, remains quarantined until fresh matching authorized response, restores ordinary controls after that response.
Keep unknown outcome no-resend, same-owner/workspace/order/device/revision/requestId guards and existing positive/validation/174 regression results.

attempt2Fix.cause: Window blur/focus is not equivalent to document visibilitychange; hidden could retain current action capability and accept a pre-hide matching GET.
attempt2Fix.changes: Visible guard at action/read/async/render boundaries, plus document visibility listener invalidating epoch/flight and clearing private state when hidden. Return visible starts new GET and requires the same existing context/revision/requestId checks. No server/identity/API/schema/price extension.
attempt2Fix.knownUnknown: Known saved revision is retained as display-only metadata. An in-flight POST hidden before reply remains unknown; its late ack is ignored and no POST is replayed.
exactOriginalCounterexamples: Loaded current view -> hidden without blur -> retained stop callback: beforePOST1, afterPOST0.

Known ack -> pending GET -> hidden without blur -> old GET reply: before private/action restored while hidden, after never restored; visible return starts fresh GET and body waits for that matching fresh response.
additionalControls: Retained stop/run callbacks denied while hidden even before event delivery; UUID0.
Hidden focus/pageshow/connection-check/manual refresh send no GET/POST; return visible GET only.
Visible fresh eligible handler can perform a deliberate new action; stale pre-hide handler remains denied.
Initial hidden/prerender sends no GET until visible; genuine empty onboarding stays deliberate.
Hidden in-flight mutation preserves unknown outcome; listener cleanup/unmount creates no reads or late writes.
